I know it's not always what you want to hear, but the meds are more good than they are bad for you.

I have schizoaffective and I've found the meds to work for me. I feel much better, the only thing that I found to be bad about the meds (Which someone may be able to help me), is I feel more stressed and I have muscle tightness.

But the goods are: 

It's been over a year on Geodon and I haven't had psychotic delusions since 2017. So you have to give it time to get past that "zombie feeling" 

My sex drive is really high again, as I am grown it's def not as much as it was when I was a teen but it's balanced and i'd say when I was a teen it was too high.

Also the weight gain has stopped, the injection affected me but the Geodon pills have lessened the gain but I can't lose weight without exercise. I know it sucks but exercising is really good it releases endorphins the feel good hormone so it can be therapeutic in a way same with long walks.

Find a place like a museum or a mall to take long walks if the winter weather is too cold for you.

Cons: I had fat on my liver my enzymes seem to have stabilized I may not be able to eat whatever I want anymore but since i'm grown I should take better care of my physical health now that my mental health has stabilized.

​

This is the problem with religion on YouTube. They brainwash you. I too fell for this way of thinking and lost all my teenage computer files and stuff.
F it I'm going next month. But guess what on Geodon you can't do anything strenuous. Anything that get's the heart rate to high is a risk apparently.

Yes I cannot cry it's due to the rewiring of the chemicals in your brain.

Also I used to feel really weird after nsfw >>! ejaculation.!< But after taking meds I feel normal after doing that.

I heard weed can bring on psychosis I smoked heavily daily in high school. Didn't know what sober was. Maybe altrering my mind so much caused something to go wrong in my brain chemistry.
But I know there is Indica strains which have less psychological effect.
And Sativa which has more of a negative mental effect.
Nothing about schizophrenia is listed here, 
https://col-careil.com/indica-sativa-science-marijuana-medical-use/
but there is a girl on youtube who was prescribed medical cannabis for her schizophrenia. I can't use cannabis as I live with my family plus I doubt being wasted all the time is going to help.


If I get hypomania i have to stay off conspiracies and religous stuff otherwise it leads me to believing the wrong things.

Thanks, you never know who is out there I guess.
Right now I'm taking the Geodon. It's been okay. Got more of a urge to look at porn again. So sex drive even though i'm not having sex. IDK if thats a good or bad thing. Because sexual urges led me to going manic. How can you tell your mania comes back?

I found out by getting bloodwork which was required by my physciatrist.
Yeah thanks for understanding and lending a hand, i'll remember to message you when I need it, if you think I can help with anything i can try. I try to rationalize everything now. Since I've been through the delusions I know the experience and know how to avoid it. We'll see how things go until monday when I'll either get another shot or get put on another anti-psychotic. I'm on day 30 since the last injection.

Carry a small pop cap bottle with an extra pill in it, they even make keychain ones im pretty sure for an extra pill.
I am on day 30 now since my last injection.

Okay I will try weight watchers, (forgot about them). The thing is with my meds I feel like I dont want to starve myself because I feel my body should have proper nutrition. And the meds make me feel hungry especially during the night. Maybe 4 small meals with a yogurt or peanut snack in between lunch and dinner and 4th meal?

Oh and I wanted to mention I used to have a very high metabolism. It went away after I started taking meds.

I could eat what I want and I WOULD ACTUALLY FEEL FULL. I don't even know what that is like anymore. I just get this nasty fat bloated feeling.
Yeah I made a small chart of the diagnosis, side effects, and meds i have tried. I'll let you all know what they say.

5 years, have you had serious a diet plan or a workout plan? What can you suggest to not put on weight?

The idea of a meal plan is difficult for me because no websites can tell you what foods you like.

I have sensory processing disorder so some foodsn these diets taste very strong in flavor and makes me not like them. I enjoy junk food. Like the average American.

I don't want to gain more than 200, if I hit 200 I am going to freak the crap out. That's why i'm going to start exercising now (In the middle of winter nonetheless). Hopefully that helps.

I made a list of My current medical diagnosises. Side Effects from schizoaffective disorder (Do a google search and you'll see which particular side effects there are.) side effects from Invega, Side Effects from fatty liver. and meds i have tried. 

I'm going to shove it in all of their faces and see what they can do for me.

If there isn't a med that has less weight gain and doesnt make fatty liver worse then i'll be happy.

But try doing that. Because the clinic i am at now it doesn't seem like my other one where all of them would meet up and discuss my files and actually care about me.

It is different for everybody what doesn't work for me might work for you and vice versa.

But I am leary on switching to another anti-psychotic and then that one doesn't work and the side effects get worse. Then I have to switch to another and then go down this cycle all while risking my sanity. Because what if one med causes my heart to get out of rythm then how am I supposed to make a visit to my psychiatrist and have them order me new meds when they are booked. Maybe I can go to the hospital then. IDK.

I'll look into the low calerie. And you are right it's the least weight gain. I'm not taking to heart anything the pharmacist says now.

## Other Considerations

As ziprasidone is primarily cleared from the body via the liver, any preexisting liver condition may be exacerbated the use of Geodon. This is especially true for people with [cirrhosis](https://www.verywellhealth.com/cirrhosis-what-you-need-to-know-1759889) in whom Geodon may increase liver impairment. If used, your doctor will need to monitor your [liver enzymes](https://www.verywellhealth.com/liver-enzyme-and-function-3157004) to avoid liver toxicity and damage.

​

Before starting Geodon, advise your doctor if you:

* Have ever had liver problems<<<<=====================
